answer_2.quote: We also perform an automatic evaluation by transcribing system outputs with a large‑vocabulary automatic speech recognition (ASR) system… Using an automatic transcription allows for much faster and more reproducible comparisons…

answer_4.quote: The human evaluator is given a set of 20 audio output files from each model being tested … and is asked to write out in words what they heard.
answer_4.guideline: Please listen to each of the attached sound files and write down what you hear as best you can. Write your transcriptions into a spreadsheet so that the row numbers match the file names. Write out what you hear as words (e.g., "five oh two pm on Thursday").
